App.demoNotice: Homepage data is illustrative, not your actual exit IP. Automatic detection is not connected yet.
App.demoFooter: Examples preview the interface and are not saved as real lookup history.
App.homeDescription: Detect the IPv4 and IPv6 exits used by this browser independently.
App.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the address manually.
App.queryDescription: Look up any public IPv4 or IPv6 address.
App.placeholder: Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 address
App.emptyQuery: Enter an IP address to view its location and network information.
App.invalidIp: Enter one valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
App.nonPublicIp: This is a non-public or reserved address; public geolocation is not available.
App.previewOnly: Live lookup is not enabled yet. Choose an example above.
App.notFoundBody: There is no page at this address.
App.noRecord: No record was found in the current databases.
App.queryUnavailable: IP information is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.
App.queryTimeout: The lookup timed out. Please retry.
App.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait before retrying.
App.historyNotice: Only successful manual public-IP lookups are saved in this browser, up to 10.
App.historyUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. New history is kept only for this page session.
App.historyClearFailed: History could not be cleared from browser storage. It may reappear after reload.
App.geoDisclaimer: IP geolocation is approximate and does not identify an exact physical location. Data provided by
App.detailsPending: Exit address detected. Loading IP information…
App.exitAddressKept: The detected address is kept and can still be copied. Retry to load its information.
App.exitNetworkHint: No address was detected on this attempt. Network, proxy or connection restrictions may affect it; this does not prove permanent lack of support.
App.exitTimeout: Detection timed out on this attempt. Retry or check this network path.
App.exitNotice: Addresses are observed by direct IPv4 / IPv6 HTTPS probes and are not saved to manual query history. Geolocation is approximate. Data:
App.dataUpdateWarningDetail: Database updates or reloads need attention. Valid, previously verified data remains available.
App.dataUpdatePausedDetail: The database is unavailable or has not been verified for 30 days. Basic exit detection is still available.
App.ipv6Description: Check IPv4 and IPv6 exits and the protocol used by this site request.
App.diagnosticDual: Both IPv4 and IPv6 exits are reachable
App.diagnosticV4Observed: IPv4 exit confirmed; IPv6 not yet confirmed
App.diagnosticV6Observed: IPv6 exit confirmed; IPv4 not yet confirmed
App.diagnosticSummaryHint: These results describe this attempt, not a permanent classification of your device or network.
App.diagnosticConnectionHint: The exit protocol observed for a request to the main site.
App.diagnosticDirectHint: A direct HTTPS request to the dedicated protocol endpoint.
App.diagnosticConnectionScope: The protocol reported by the trusted site entry may differ from the direct exits.
App.diagnosticDirectScope: Confirms the exit seen by this endpoint; it does not prove native interface support.
App.diagnosticTimeout: This attempt timed out. Retry to check this path.
App.diagnosticFailed: This path was not confirmed. Network, proxy or browser restrictions may affect it.
App.diagnosticLimitations: Each request has a 5-second limit. Timings include request and response processing, may reuse connections, and are not ICMP ping or a protocol speed ranking. VPNs, proxies and NAT64 can affect the observed exits. No diagnosis is saved to recent queries.
App.routingDescription: Observe exit addresses reported by different sites, grouped by protocol and IP.
App.routingConsent: Starting a check sends credential-free requests directly from your browser to those sites, which can see your exit IP. Nothing runs automatically.
App.routingNone: No exit confirmed yet. Unconfirmed targets are excluded from IP groups.
App.routingMultiple: Multiple exit addresses were observed within the same protocol.
App.routingNoMultiple: No multiple exits within one protocol have appeared in the confirmed results so far.
App.routingGroupHint: Groups use each target’s latest successful result. IPv4 and IPv6 are counted separately. Results do not establish proxy use or service access. Retest all after changing networks.
App.routingFilterHint: The category filters this list; the summary still includes all confirmed results.
App.routingTimeout: The request timed out. Retry later.
App.routingRequestFailed: The response could not be read. Cross-origin, network or browser restrictions may affect it.
App.routingHttpError: The endpoint returned HTTP {status}; no exit was obtained.
App.routingNoIp: The response has no readable public-IP field. This does not mean the site is unavailable.
App.routingInvalidData: The exit field is invalid or non-public and is excluded from results.
App.routingTooLarge: The response exceeded the size limit; no exit was obtained.
App.routingLimitations: At most 4 requests run concurrently, with a 6-second limit per target. Duration is HTTPS request time, not ping. Only public diagnostic endpoints are checked, not whole-site or account access. Nothing is added to recent queries.
